create_wav2vec2_config: create a Wav2Vec2Config dataclass instance with default base architecture settings for a wav2vec 2.0 model
create_wav2vec2_encoder_config: create a Wav2Vec2EncoderConfig dataclass instance to configure the wav2vec 2.0 encoder with model dimensions and dropout
validate_encoder_config: validate a Wav2Vec2EncoderConfig instance to check conformer and norm_order compatibility constraints
register_wav2vec2_configs: register base, large, and large_lv60k wav2vec 2.0 architecture configs with a DependencyContainer
customize_wav2vec2_masking: customize temporal and spatial masking parameters on a Wav2Vec2Config for self-supervised pretraining
